(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1 further comprising: __optionally__ displaying the filtered EPG information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __from the content delivery provider__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber __from an external source__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber __from the channel subscription information obtained__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if __it is determined that__ the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers.
